models.name: discussion_board_guest
models.description:
Unauthenticated guest users, representing visitors with read-only access to the discussion board.

Guests cannot create accounts or sessions, and have minimal identifying information mainly for tracking or analytics.

This table allows the system to recognize guest interactions while maintaining privacy and simplicity.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Guest user display nickname, optional and may be used for distinguishing guests in anonymous interactions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

models.name: discussion_board_member
models.description:
Registered members of the discussion board capable of creating articles and comments.

Members can log in with credentials and manage their content.

This table stores essential user information including authentication data and timestamps for auditing and soft deletion.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for authentication and communication. Must be unique across members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Display name chosen by the member for identification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

models.name: discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description:
Active session records for registered members, tracking login state and connection details.

Each session is linked to a member and stores IP address, URL, referrer, creation time, and expiry time.

This supports authentication session management and audit logging.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who owns this session. {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session originated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the connection request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer URL.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry timestamp; null means session is active.

models.name: discussion_board_admin
models.description:
System administrators with full permissions over the discussion board.

Admins can manage all content and users, with login credentials for authentication.

Timestamps and soft deletion fields help track administrative activity and account state.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for administrator login and communication. Must be unique among admins.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for authentication.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Display name for the administrator user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null means active.

models.name: discussion_board_admin_sessions
models.description:
Active session records for administrators, enabling authentication and audit logging.

Sessions include IP address, connection URL, referrer, creation time, and optional expiration timestamp.

Linked to the administrator who owns the session, supporting secure session management.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator owning this session. {@link discussion_board_admin.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of connection origin.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session start timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session end timestamp; null if ongoing.

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description:
Articles posted by registered members on economic and political topics.

Each article includes a title and textual content, an author reference to the registered member who created it, and temporal fields for creation, updates, and soft deletion. Articles serve as the primary content entity for the discussion board.

Attachments and comments related to articles are managed separately in other components to maintain modularity and normalize content storage.

This design supports efficient browsing, editing, and moderation with clear ownership and audit trail capabilities.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who authored the article. {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the article representing its main subject or headline.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Body content of the article containing detailed economic or political discussion.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the article was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking the last update to the article.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if the article is active.

models.name: discussion_board_attachments
models.description:
Attachments linked to discussion board articles.

Supports both images and files uploaded by members to complement article content. Each attachment is associated with a single article and contains metadata such as type (image or file), file URL, and filename.

Attachments are soft deletable to retain audit trails and support content management workflows.

This table is a subsidiary entity managed through its parent article.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent article. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Attachment type indicating whether this is an image or other file. Valid values: 'image', 'file'.

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: URL path to the stored attachment resource.

plainFields.name: filename
plainFields.description: Original name of the uploaded file.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; if set, this record is considered deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_comments
models.description:
User comments on articles in the discussion board.

Each comment is authored by a registered member and linked to a specific article. Comments contain text-only content, supporting the core discussion functionality without attachments. The model supports creation, update, and soft deletion timestamps to enable auditability and moderation.

This model has a primary stance reflecting its role as an independently managed business entity requiring full CRUD operations and search capabilities across all comments.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_article_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the article being commented on. {@link discussion_board_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member who authored the comment. {@link discussion_board_member.id}.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Text content of the comment, supporting the discussion without attachments.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion; null if not deleted.
